page.overview:
Who is Twilight Sky?

Twilight Sky is a male background pony with a medium gray coat, light blue mane and tail, blue eyes, and a cutie mark of three white stars. He is an Earth pony both in his few in-show appearances and in all merchandise, while he is a Pegasus in most in-show appearances. He is unnamed in the show, but he is named in merchandise.__TOC__

Twilight Sky shares his mane and tail designs and sometimes pony kind with Star Hunter and "Cosmic", shares only his mane and tail designs with Neon Lights, Dark Moon, "Flank Sinatra", S02E26 Unnamed Unicorn Stallion #1, S02E26 Unnamed Unicorn Stallion #2, and sometimes the unicorn version of Shooting Star, and shares his cutie mark and sometimes tail design with "Sir Pony Moore".

In Hearth's Warming Eve, Twilight Sky takes part in the pageant as one of the hungry Pegasus ponies living in the Pegasi's cloud city. He appears again as a Pegasus in Hurricane Fluttershy as one of the Pegasi enlisted to help with transporting water to Cloudsdale.

In Games Ponies Play, Twilight Sky appears briefly as a Pegasus in Rainbow Dash's flashback of when Cloudsdale lost the Equestria Games to Fillydelphia.
